calibration_assignment: first eight hex digits of sha256('public-calib-v1:' + parent_recording_id), divided by 2**32, less than 0.25; publisher training population only
threshold: clean calibration 0.95 empirical quantile, method=higher; alarm strictly score > threshold
bootstrap_unit: publisher parent-recording ID, all retained rows of an ID together; acquisition-session independence unknown
fiot_selection: ALL publisher parent-recording IDs, crop 0 only (878 train / 243 test); expansion capped at 2 GiB and 300 seconds on two CPU cores; fixed before detector metrics
lc_selection: all publisher train/test records, at most 1024 per partition; empty recordings are abstentions with explicit counts
fiot_units: stored RGB image levels, not calibrated PSD, IQ or linear RF power

directions.distances: higher means more interference-like; never flip from test results

fitting: clean center/standard deviation and constant-column mask from fitting-train clean records only; positive centroid from fitting-train native labels != 0 only
selection: no hyperparameter/checkpoint search; publisher test never fits statistics or thresholds
capacity_decision: Initial 256-parent access pilot had only 7 clean calibration / 16 clean test records; expanded to all published parent crop-0 IDs before first score computation, without changing scoring or split rules
